title: CrmConvertContactOutput
description: ADR 0209 §3 conversion outcome. A refusal at the surface (tenant guard, link validation, cap, tombstone) is a TYPED node failure, never a success with an empty entity.

contact.description: The contact row as the surface projects it (host bookkeeping columns `tenantId`/`orgId`/`createdBy`/`updatedBy` stripped).

company.description: The company row as the surface projects it (host bookkeeping columns `tenantId`/`orgId`/`createdBy`/`updatedBy` stripped).

deal.description: The deal row as the surface projects it (host bookkeeping columns `tenantId`/`orgId`/`createdBy`/`updatedBy` stripped).

created.description: Which of company/deal this call CREATED vs reused (idempotent-by-outcome: a re-convert reuses the open deal).
